s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging painful mass in the thigh with malignant features
salient_findings: 20 × 10 cm swelling over the anterior and anterolateral aspects of the thigh
Cells with vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders on fine-needle aspiration cytology
key_facts: 51-year-old man
Mass in the left thigh
First noted 10 years previously
Painful for the past 6 months
No bone involvement on plain radiographs
MRI demonstrated a heterogeneous intramuscular mass
Lesion preserved the plane between the lesion and the neurovascular bundle
Fine-needle aspiration cytology showed sheets and clusters of monotomous cells
Cells had vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders
Cells formed small anastomosing cords and exhibited a single-file arrangement

differentials: Myxofibrosarcoma-like morphologic pattern of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
per_call: Myxofibrosarcoma-like morphologic pattern of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor

shortlist.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical and cytological findings match this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant features and myxoid stroma are consistent with this entity

shortlist.label: Low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Preservation of plane between lesion and neurovascular bundle and lack of significant pleomorphism support this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous intramuscular mass with myxoid features is plausible for this rare entity

shortlist.label: Liposarcoma with myxoid features
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation and cytological findings could be consistent with a liposarcoma variant

raw.rationale: The presence of a heterogeneous intramuscular mass with a prominent myxoid stroma, cells with vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders, and a single-file arrangement are characteristic of myxoid liposarcoma.

rejected.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: Typically shows a higher degree of cellular pleomorphism and atypia

rejected.label: Low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma
rejected.why: Usually exhibits a more uniform fibrous and myxoid pattern

rejected.label: Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
rejected.why: Typically shows a more chondroid appearance and lacks the characteristic lipoblasts of myxoid liposarcoma

rejected.label: Liposarcoma with myxoid features
rejected.why: Myxoid liposarcoma is a more specific diagnosis that matches the provided clinical and cytological findings
